The '''2002 World Championship''' was the 7th Star Wars CCG World Championship and the first run by the [[Players Committee]]. It was played at [[DecipherCon 2002]] at the Chesapeake Conference Center from 31 October to 3 November 2002.<ref name="dcon-fmt">[https://web.archive.org/web/20020810223927/http://www.decipher.com/deciphercon/2002/events/worldsformats.html World Championship Event Formats & Prizes] (Wayback, 10 August 2002)</ref><ref name="tfn">[https://www.theforce.net/ccg/story/World_Championship_Results_announced_64778.asp World Championship Results announced], theforce.net (3 November 2002)</ref><ref name="pc-sw">[https://web.archive.org/web/20021221153832/http://www.decipher.com/deciphercon/2002/reports/1103swyjjkresults.html Star Wars Players Committee 2002 World Championships], Kathy McCracken, Decipher Daily News (3 November 2002)</ref> The Players Committee's awards page gives the site as "DecipherCon – Virginia Beach, VA".<ref name="awards">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/community/awards/ Awards and Hall of Fame], starwarsccg.org; Wayback [https://web.archive.org/web/20230817222457/https://www.starwarsccg.org/community/awards/ 17 August 2023]</ref> [[Angelo Consoli]] of Germany won with a Dark [[No Money, No Parts, No Deal! / You're A Slave?|No Money, No Parts, No Deal!]] (Watto) deck and a Light [[Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation|Quiet Mining Colony]] deck, beating [[Greg Shaw]] in a final that ended at 5:30 AM on Sunday.<ref name="tfn" /><ref name="pc-sw" /><ref name="d4">[https://web.archive.org/web/20030220124438/http://www.decipher.com/deciphercon/2002/reports/1103dayfourwrapup.html Until Next Time: Day Four Wrapup], Marcus Sheppard, Decipher Daily News (3 November 2002)</ref> The purse was $10,000.<ref name="dcon-fmt" />

The constructed pool was [[Premiere - Original VS3]]: printed sets through [[Theed Palace]] plus original virtual cards through [[Virtual Set 3: Revolution|VS3]] (legal 20 September 2002).

== Results ==

Places as announced at the Sunday awards by [[Jim Colson]].<ref name="tfn" /><ref name="pc-sw" /> Decks are the lists recovered in 2026 from DeckTech posts (Internet Archive copies) and Players Committee decklist forms; each deck page cites its own source. Prizes are from Decipher's event page.<ref name="dcon-fmt" />

The official results tie places 3–4 and 5–8. The 2026 decklist recovery numbered them 3rd Fred, 4th Terwilliger, 5th Hunter, 6th Chu, 7th Rippetoe and 8th Winkelhaus; no source for that order has been found. A 2020 forum compilation lists [[Clint Hays]] in place of Hayes Hunter among 5th–8th; a reply in the same thread corrects it to Hayes Hunter, as in the official results.<ref name="f75427-1300387">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1300387#p1300387 Post by Yoshi], "SWCCG Worlds Day 3 Standings History", forum.starwarsccg.org (28 May 2020). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20211006195438/https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=75427 Internet Archive], [https://web.archive.org/web/20261012152200/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t75427.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="f75427-1300392">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1300392#p1300392 Post by Death Star], "SWCCG Worlds Day 3 Standings History", forum.starwarsccg.org (28 May 2020). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20211006195438/https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=75427 Internet Archive], [https://web.archive.org/web/20261012152200/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t75427.html Internet Archive]</ref>

=== Top 8 bracket ===

The top 8 played single elimination from 6:00 PM on Saturday 2 November; the final ended at 5:30 AM on Sunday 3 November.<ref name="pc-sw" /><ref name="d4" /> The quarterfinal and semifinal pairings and game results were not published in the sources found.

=== Schedule ===

Two Day 1 heats ran on Thursday 31 October and Friday 1 November at 2:00 PM: six games of Swiss, with the top 20% advancing to Day 2. Day 2 on Saturday 2 November started at 10:00 AM.<ref name="swsched">[https://web.archive.org/web/20021023190505/http://www.decipher.com/deciphercon/2002/events/eventschedule-otherccg.html Event schedule: Star Wars, Young Jedi, Jedi Knights], Decipher (Wayback 23 October 2002)</ref><ref name="tfn-sched">[https://www.theforce.net/ccg/story/Star_Wars_CCG_Explodes_at_DecipherCon_2002_65230.asp Star Wars CCG Explodes at DecipherCon 2002], theforce.net (20 September 2002)</ref><ref name="pc-sw" /> No Day 1 or Day 2 standings have been found.
